# v0.9.0b3 — App pages in the Home Assistant look

Update the app to **0.9.0b3** together with the integration.

- **The app's web pages look like Home Assistant.** They use the whole width,
  show their cards side by side on a wide screen and follow light and dark
  mode. One bar groups the pages into **Overview**, **Charging**,
  **Settings** and **Log**.
- **No more white flash between pages.** The bar arrives with the page, in your
  language, and scripts and styles are not loaded again with every page.
- **The registers are part of the overview** instead of a page of their own.
- **The log runs by itself.** The former Debug log tab is the **Log** page. It
  starts when you open it, adds one line per bus transaction, follows the
  newest line and can be paused, filtered and downloaded. The recording ends
  within ten minutes after the page is closed.
  See [the app's web pages](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.9.0b3/docs/app-guide.md).
